{{Quote|If you're looking for the best-defended black market in the galaxy, Petabys Station is the place to be...there are never pirate attacks and the place has enough defenses to hold off a small fleet. Of course, the rates are high, but what do you expect at a former battle station?|Comment overheard in [[The Broken Tusk (Reuss VIII)|The Broken Tusk]]|<ref name="H&S" />}}
'''Petabys Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] housing a [[Black market/Legends|black market]]<ref name="H&S" /> in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[Halm sector/Legends|Halm sector]].<ref name="TEAOC" /> It was a [[Rendili StarDrive/Legends|Rendili StarDrive]] [[FireStar-class Orbital Defense Station|''FireStar'' Orbital Defense Station]] originally used to defend mining operations on a small [[Moon/Legends|moon]] located at the edge of a [[Binary star/Legends|binary]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]. After a cost/benefit analysis, the parent company of the mine chose to sell the station rather than move it, a decision bolstered by an aggressive sales campaign by space station developer [[Golan Arms/Legends|Golan Arms]]. The station was purchased by [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[black marketeer]] [[Uopled]] at a bargain price. Uopled modified the station to better serve its new role, converting cargo shuttle landing bays into freighter bays for his buyers and sellers, maintaining half of the stations fighter bays to house three [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], and converting many core levels of the station into sales centers. All of the station's defensive systems were retained, ensuring anyone laying siege to it faced a protracted and challenging fight.<ref name="H&S" />
